| Placement | Anchored to a 1×1 rect at the pointer (end of the selection, or the pointer when the shortcut fired; from the menu it uses the last pointer position in the preview, else the centre). Opens on the right unless `anchor.maxX + width + 30` reaches the screen's visible edge, then on the left (`:138-155, 358-370`) |
| Behaviour | `.applicationDefined` (no outside-click dismissal); animates unless Reduce Motion; Space always goes to the text view; ⌘↩ saves; a blank comment beeps; Escape cancels and consumes the whole press including repeats ("Hold Escape to dismiss the annotation, then release and press it again to close Quick Look") (`:64-66`; `AttachmentPreviewController.swift:397-448, 609-618`) |

**Saving and attaching to the next message.** On Save, a conversation source (message text or window PNG) is imported first, then the note `Annotation — <source stem ≤160 chars>.<txt|png>`. If the second import fails, the first is rolled back, so nothing is persisted before Save (`ConversationAnnotationContent.swift:12-31`). Only the note joins `drafts[conversationID].attachments`. The source becomes an ordinary conversation attachment that the note references (`NoodleStore.swift:1740-1759`). After a conversation note is saved, focus returns to the composer, "ready to submit the draft" (`AttachmentPreviewController.swift:636-645`; `CHANGELOG.md:834`). Draft notes survive relaunch: `restoreAnnotations` re-adds any note no sent message references (`AttachmentAnnotation.swift:80-88`). A note can be edited only while it is in the draft and unreferenced (`:74-78`). It goes out with the next Send, alone or with text, and "Everyone in the conversation receives it. Sent annotations can no longer be edited, even while they wait to be delivered" (`docs/attachment-annotations.md:45-47`). Removing the chip deletes the file (`NoodleStore.swift:1779-1789`).

**Draft chip** (`ChatView.swift:625-687`): height 28; padding 9 leading, 5 trailing; HStack spacing 6; icon `text.bubble.fill` in blue, width 14; title = the comment with whitespace collapsed, 1 line, tail-truncated; remove button `xmark.circle.fill`, secondary, help "Remove Attachment"; `.caption` font; Liquid Glass capsule; max width 260. Tooltip "Annotation on <file>\n\n<comment>". Context menu: "Copy" (`doc.on.doc`), divider, "Quick Look" (`eye`), "Remove Attachment" (`xmark`, destructive). The chip row scrolls horizontally with spacing 7 and is inset 44 (36 + 8) to line up with the input (`:383-405, 224-225`).

**Card in the transcript** (`AttachmentPreview.swift:347-377`): VStack spacing 10, padding 14, idealWidth and maxWidth 280. Fill `.quaternary` at 30% in radius 13, stroke orange at 20%. Contents: `Label("Annotation", systemImage: "text.bubble.fill")` in caption semibold orange; source filename in caption secondary, 1 line. Then either the quote (callout, secondary, 3 lines, leading padding 9, a 2 pt orange-60% rule on the left) or the marked thumbnail (fixed height 190 for image notes so rows never jump; clipped at radius 8; placeholder `Label("Marked preview region", systemImage: "viewfinder")`). Last comes the comment (callout, 4 lines).

**Review window** (`AnnotationPreview.swift:19-243`), opened by clicking a chip or card. It is a panel 860×740 for region notes or 680×480 otherwise (min 420×320), centred on the chat's screen, titled "Annotation — <file>", always dark. It uses the shared `AnnotationPreviewFrame` (HUD material, radius 18, 1 pt white-22% border, 36 pt draggable header with an 18×18 `xmark.circle.fill`, 13 pt semibold title, 11 pt medium kind label "Annotation", 5 pt content inset at radius 13; close hint "Close Preview (Esc or ⌘W)"; `AgentActivityWindow.swift:303-363`). Body variants:
- region: image on black 60%, or `Label("The saved image is unavailable.", systemImage: "photo.badge.exclamationmark")`;
- quote: "Selected text" (11 pt medium, secondary) above the quote (16 pt, line spacing 5, 2 pt orange-80% rule, 16 leading), padding 28, on black 30%;
- whole attachment: header "Whole attachment" and the comment at 16 pt.

For quote and region notes a comment strip follows: a white-8% divider, the header `Label("Comment", systemImage: "text.bubble")` (11 pt medium, secondary) with an "Edit Comment" text button, and the comment (14 pt, line spacing 3), padding 18×14, on white 3.5%. Its height is clamped between 72 and 30% of the window (50% while editing). The editor is a 14 pt TextEditor, padding 7, on black 20% at radius 7 with a white-18% stroke, height 90. Cancel and Save are small; Save (⌘↩) is disabled while the comment is blank, and Escape ends editing.

**Saved image** (`AnnotationContent.swift:48-78`): drawn at the captured pixel size with line width `max(2, imageWidth / 450)`. A black-70% stroke at that width + 2 goes down first, then pure orange RGB(255, 140, 0) at that width, so the mark reads on light and busy images. The live selection uses systemOrange; the saved mark uses this fixed orange with a dark halo.

**Data shape** (`Sources/NoodleCore/AttachmentAnnotation.swift:5-71`), stored as metadata on the annotation attachment:

```swift
struct AttachmentAnnotation { struct Region { let x, y, width, height: Double } // fractions, bottom-left origin
  let version: Int            // 2 (1 = legacy PDF report)
  let sourceAttachmentID: UUID; let sourceFilename: String
  let sourceMessageID: UUID?  // set for conversation text quotes
  let quote: String?; private(set) var comment: String   // comment trimmed
  let region: Region? }       // valid: comment non-blank, region within 0...1, never both quote and region
```

The media type is `text/plain` (`.txt`) without a region and `image/png` with one. The `.txt` content is `textRepresentation`: "Annotation — <file>\n\nComment\n<comment>\n\n<Selected text\n<quote> | This comment refers to the whole attachment. | The marked preview snapshot follows on the next page.>\n\nSource attachment: <uuid>\n[Source message: <uuid>\n]" (`:65-70`). Bots receive the comment, the quote or snapshot, and where it came from (`docs/attachment-annotations.md:55`).

**State machine:** idle → *preparing* (copying the selection, or capturing the window; Escape cancels) → *selecting region* (region only) → *commenting* (popover) → **saved** (chip in the draft; focus returns to the composer or preview) or **cancelled**. Saved → *editing* (review window, draft only) → saved. Saved → **sent** (read-only).

### 2.3 Voice messages

**Entry points.** The `mic` button (16 pt, 27×36 hit area) sits left of Send inside the composer pill, help "Record Voice Message (⇧⌘D)" (`ChatView.swift:451-462`; visible in `hero.png`). Other entry points: ⇧⌘D "Record / Stop Voice Message"; the Conversation menu item titled "Record Voice Message" or "Stop Recording"; and ⇧⌘D in the Choose Conversation grid (`ConversationCommands.swift:7-42, 111-113`; `docs/usage.md:58-62`). Docs require macOS 26 and Apple's on-device transcription for the Mac and its language (`docs/voice-messages.md:5-7`). Microphone access is asked for only when recording starts.

**The composer swap.** While the phase is not idle, the input pill is replaced by the recording bar in the same row beside the "+" button. The text draft is untouched (`VoiceMessageComposer.swift:26-31`; `ChatView.swift:267-272`).

| Element | Spec (`VoiceMessageComposer.swift`) |
|---|---|
| Container | Padding 12 horizontal; 8 bottom only when an error or retry row shows; min height 36; Liquid Glass `.regular` in a continuous RoundedRectangle radius 18, the same as the composer pill (36 tall, radius 18, `ChatView.swift:374-377`). Takes keyboard focus on appear (`:87-92`) |
| Row | HStack spacing 10, height 36, tooltip "Microphone: <device name>" (`:32, 75-76`) |
| Discard | `xmark`, plain; Escape (cancel action); help "Discard Recording (Escape)"; disabled while sending (`:35-37`) |
| Preparing, finishing | Small spinner + caption secondary: "Preparing speech…", "Downloading speech model…", "Starting microphone…" or "Finishing transcription…"; then a spacer (`:38-42`; `VoiceRecorder.swift:21, 180, 184`) |
| Recording dot | Red circle 6×6 (`:44`) |
| Middle | Live waveform (height 22) while recording; saved overview (height 22) when ready or failed. Replaced by "Reconnecting microphone…" or "No sound from <device>" (tooltip "Check the microphone’s mute switch."), caption secondary, 1 line (`:45-60`) |
| Time | "m:ss", caption with monospaced digits (`:61`; `VoiceMessagePlayer.swift:209-212`) |
| Stop | `stop.fill`, only while recording; help "Stop Recording (⇧⌘D)" (`:62-65`) |
| Send | `arrow.up.circle.fill` 23 pt in system **blue** (the composer's send uses the accent colour); Return (default action); help "Send Voice Message (Return)"; enabled only while recording or ready (`:67-73`) |
| Below | Error line (caption, red; a send error wins). When failed with audio: "Retry Transcription" and "Send Audio Only", disabled while sending (`:77-85`) |

A failure with no audio (for example, permission denied) shows the overview of an empty waveform, which draws one 2 pt bar the full width, "0:00", and the red error, with no retry buttons.

**State machine** (`VoiceRecorder.swift:14`):

| Phase | Entered by | Exits |
|---|---|---|
| idle | Launch without a draft; discard; successful send | Start (mic, ⇧⌘D, menu) → preparing |
| preparing | `start()`: transcriber and locale, optional model download, mic permission, best audio format, speech analyzer, engine started and verified (`:59-112`) | Verified capture → recording; error → failed; Escape → idle; leaving the chat → discarded |
| recording | Capture verified; draft persisted (`:111-112`) | Stop or ⇧⌘D → finishing; Send or Return → finishing, then sent if ready; 600 s or a sink error → finishing; leaving the chat → finishing (draft kept); a dead microphone → failed |
| finishing | `finish()` or `retry()` | Transcript complete → ready; otherwise failed (30 s watchdog) |
| ready | Finalized with a transcript (`:243-246`) | Send → message, then idle; Escape → idle |
| failed | Any error | Retry → finishing; Send Audio Only → idle; Escape → idle |

⇧⌘D only does idle → start and recording → finish. It is disabled while preparing, finishing, sending or reviewing (`ConversationCommands.swift:14-24`; `docs/voice-messages.md:15-16`). It ignores key repeats, requires the exact binding when ⌘ or ⌃ is held, and is off while a sheet or modal is up or a new shortcut is being recorded (`ConversationCommands.swift:28-41`).

**Live waveform** (`VoiceMessagePlayer.swift:7-65`, data from `VoiceRecorder.swift:439-457`). It runs on a fixed time scale, independent of callback size:
1. The sink keeps one peak (max |sample|, over all channels, Float/Int16/Int32 normalised) per 50 ms bucket (`sampleRate × 0.05` frames) of the converted audio actually written, and only the last 240 buckets (12 s).
2. Bars are 2.5 wide, one every 5 pt, newest at the right edge, older ones further left: `x = width − age × 5` with `age = position − index`. `position = max(samples.count, duration / 0.05)` and is animated `.linear(duration: 0.1)` (none with Reduce Motion). Bars off either edge are skipped, and the shape is clipped.
3. Height uses a fixed decibel window rather than normalisation: `dB = 20·log10(max(1e-6, amp))`, `norm = clamp((dB + 60) / 48, 0, 1)`, so −60 dBFS reads as floor and −12 dBFS as full. `barHeight = min(h, 2 + max(0, norm·h − 2) · min(1, age))`: a new bar grows in over its first 50 ms from a 2 pt minimum. Bars are vertically centred, with corner radius 1.25, filled with the primary colour at 70% opacity.

Mobile improves the motion: it draws from a TimelineView following the clock 250 ms behind, `position = min(count, max(0, (elapsed − 0.25) / 0.05))`, so audio that arrives in uneven chunks is already there when it scrolls in (`Mobile/Sources/NoodleMobile/VoiceMessages.swift:467-499`).

**Overview waveform** (saved metadata and player, `VoiceMessagePlayer.swift:67-85`; `VoiceRecorder.swift:409-437`). One peak per delivered tap buffer (4096 frames at the input rate, roughly 85 ms at 48 kHz, inferred), capped at 20,000 peaks. These are max-pooled into at most 100 points (`width = ceil(count / 100)`). The view draws `count = min(60, samples.count)` bars evenly across the width (`step = width / count`, bar width `max(1, step − 2)`, i.e. a 2 pt gap), so short clips get fewer, wider bars. Height is `max(2, sqrt(value) · height)`, centred, radius 2. The played portion (`index / count < progress`) is accent, the rest secondary at 60%.

**Transcription** (`VoiceRecorder.swift:170-248`). Apple's on-device `SpeechTranscriber` with the `.progressiveTranscription` preset and the supported equivalent of the current locale. The model downloads on first use ("Downloading speech model…"). The live transcript is the finalized segments plus the current partial, joined by spaces (`:188-204`). It is not shown while recording. Finalizing has a 30 s watchdog ("Transcription timed out. Your recording is preserved."). Any recognition error, an empty transcript or missing audio leads to failed with "No speech recognised. Retry transcription or send audio only." Noodle never silently sends a partial transcript (`:238-242`). Retry re-analyses the saved file (`:250-274`). Bots receive the audio and, when present, the transcript (`docs/voice-messages.md:27-29`). People read it with right-click → "Show Transcript" (`text.alignleft`), which opens a sheet: width 440, padding 20, spacing 16; header "Transcript" (headline) with a "Done" text button in blue; selectable text in a scroll view of max height 340; fallback "No transcript available." (`VoiceMessagePlayer.swift:214-229`; `MessageContextMenu.swift:70-72`).

**Recovery after interruption:**
- *Startup*: the engine must be running and the written duration must advance on 2 consecutive 100 ms checks. Noodle restarts the engine at most 5 times and gives up after 50 checks (5 s): "The microphone didn’t start responding. Please try recording again." (`VoiceCaptureRecovery.swift:32-91`).
- *Hung hardware*: every Core Audio call runs on one serial queue with a 5 s deadline. One miss marks the device unresponsive and later calls fail at once: "The microphone isn’t responding. Reconnect it or choose another in Settings → Chat." (`:94-142`).
- *While recording* (100 ms meter, `VoiceRecorder.swift:113-159`). No signal means 3 s since the last sample above 0.0001 (about −80 dBFS) while the engine runs and is not stalled; this shows "No sound from <device>". A stall is the engine stopped, or the duration unchanged for 10 ticks (1 s). It shows "Reconnecting microphone…" and restarts capture. If the restart fails, Noodle keeps the audio and fails with "The microphone stopped responding. Your audio is preserved; retry transcription or send audio only."
- *Transcriber overload*: the speech queue keeps 64 buffers (oldest first). On a drop: "Live transcription fell behind. The recording is preserved; retry transcription." (`:81, 411-414`). Format changes mid-recording rebuild the converter (`:384-386`).
- *Persistence*: `recording.caf` and `draft.json` live in `<conversation attachments>/VoiceDraft/`, one recorder per conversation (`NoodleStore.swift:131-137`). The draft is written when recording starts, every 1 s, and after finalizing. On launch it restores as ready, or as failed with "Recording preserved. Retry transcription or send audio only." (`VoiceRecorder.swift:42-57, 112, 152, 247, 334-337`).
- *Switching chats*: the last composer detaching finishes a recording, which keeps its draft with that chat, and discards one still preparing (`VoiceRecorder.swift:276-289`). Mobile instead discards on leaving (`Mobile/Sources/NoodleMobile/Chats.swift:1680`).

**Input device selection.** Settings → Conversation → "Microphone" picker. The first entry is "System Default — <current default name>" (or "System Default"), then every input device sorted by name, plus "Selected microphone unavailable" if the saved one is gone. The list refreshes every 2 s while shown (`NoodleSettingsView.swift:176-194`). Noodle stores the stable device UID under `voiceInputDeviceUID`, never the transient id; empty means follow the system, and the choice affects Noodle only (`VoiceInputDevice.swift:5-8, 48-69`). Errors: "No microphone is available. Connect one and choose it in Settings → Chat.", "The selected microphone is disconnected. Choose another in Settings → Chat.", "Couldn’t open <name> (<status>). Try recording again." The tab is labelled **Conversation** (`NoodleSettingsView.swift:47-52`), so "Settings → Chat" in these strings is stale. Settings → Permissions lists Microphone (`mic`) with the summary "Record voice messages." and a status of "Allowed", "Not requested" (with "Request") or "Not allowed" (with "Open System Settings") (`PermissionsSettingsView.swift:16-38, 224-260`).

**Limits:**

| Limit | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Recording length | 600 s, then automatic finish, never automatic send | `VoiceRecorder.swift:153`; docs |
| Valid duration | > 0 and ≤ 660 s | `VoiceMessage.swift:18-22` |
| Waveform | ≤ 100 points produced (≤ 120 accepted), each 0…1 | `VoiceRecorder.swift:428-437`; `VoiceMessage.swift:20` |
| Transcript | ≤ 128,000 UTF-8 bytes; locale id ≤ 100 chars | `VoiceMessage.swift:21` |
| Peak history, live history | 20,000 peaks; 240 × 50 ms | `VoiceRecorder.swift:410, 452` |

**Sending** (`NoodleStore.swift:1423-1445`). The `.caf` is imported as an `audio/x-caf` attachment with `VoiceMessage` metadata {transcript, duration, waveform, localeIdentifier}. Noodle then sends a user message with body "Voice message" whose attachments are the staged draft files followed by the recording. Staged files are cleared; typed text stays in the box (`CHANGELOG.md:471`). A message whose body is "Voice message" and whose attachments are all voice shows no text bubble, only the player (`Components.swift:376-379`).

**Player** (`VoiceMessagePlayer.swift:158-207`): VStack spacing 4, padding 12×7, idealWidth and maxWidth 270, `.regularMaterial` at radius 16. Inside, an HStack spacing 10:
- `play.fill` or `pause.fill`, 28×32;
- the waveform, height 28, filling the width. A **click** seeks to `x / width`; dragging the player exports the file instead (CHANGELOG.md:818). Accessibility: "Playback position", value m:ss, adjustable ±5 s;
- time, caption monospaced, secondary: the position while playing, else the total duration.

A red caption error ("The recording couldn’t be played.") can follow. Position updates every 100 ms. Only one recording plays app-wide, because starting one pauses the previous. Playback rewinds to 0 at the end and stops when scrolled out of view or removed (`VoiceMessagePlayer.swift:97-156`).

### 2.4 Voice calls

**Eligibility and entry.** Calls need a direct conversation with one bot whose harness has voices, which today is only Codex: feminine juniper, maple, sol, vale; masculine arbor, breeze, cove, ember, spruce; defaults juniper or cove. The bot must run on this Mac, or be a Hub bot the Hub says can call. Calling starts a stopped bot (`NoodleStore.swift:1389-1414`; `Sources/NoodleCore/VoiceCall.swift:98-120`). There is one call app-wide, and starting another hangs up the first (`VoiceCall.swift:90, 126-129`). Entry points: the toolbar `Label("Call", systemImage: "phone")` (help "Call <name>"); ⇧⌘C ("Call" or "End Call" in the Conversation menu, repeats ignored); a "Call" action on the bot's profile card; ⇧⌘C in Choose Conversation (`VoiceCallToolbar.swift:13-18`; `ConversationCommands.swift:114-119`; `AgentProfileSheet.swift:129-139`).

**Media.** WebKit provides WebRTC, echo cancellation and playback, from an invisible 1×1 borderless window at alpha 0 ("WebKit suspends audio in a web view that is not on screen"). The page `LinkCallMedia.page` loads at the secure origin `https://call.noodle.invalid/` (`VoiceCall.swift:205-262`; `LinkCall.swift:92-231`). The page creates an SDP offer; on the Mac the microphone has echoCancellation, noiseSuppression and autoGainControl all on. The runtime, or the Hub, relays it to the voice service and returns the answer. Events are `answer`, `started`, `line(speaker person|bot, text, at)` and `ended(detail?)` (`NoodleCore/VoiceCall.swift:35-61`). Audio never passes through the Hub (`LinkCall.swift:3-5`). The last 12 non-system messages travel as context (`NoodleStore.swift:1399-1405`).

**States** (`VoiceCall.swift:91-203`, `VoiceCallToolbar.swift`):

| State | Condition | Toolbar | Conversation |
|---|---|---|---|
| idle | No call | "Call" button (if eligible) | — |
| connecting | Call exists, `startedAt` nil | `phone.fill` secondary, "--:--", help "Connecting"; Mute and End live | No card yet (only connected calls get one, `VoiceCall.swift:183-184`) |
| connected (talking) | Runtime `started` → `startedAt` set, chime | `phone.fill` green, timer ticking every 1 s, help "On a call" | Card with live timer and green `phone.fill`; transcript blocks grow |
| muted (flag) | Mute toggled, also while connecting | `mic.slash.fill`, label "Unmute" | — |
| ended | Hang up, runtime `ended`, media failure | Back to "Call" | Card shows the length; lines saved (`NoodleStore.swift:1350-1361`) |

There is no speaking indicator, level meter or call screen. The only live visuals are the green phone, the timer and the growing blocks. Failures surface in the app's error display: "This bot cannot take calls right now.", "The call connection was lost.", "Microphone access is off. Enable Noodle in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.", "Could not add the call to the conversation: …", "Could not save the call's transcript: …".

**Toolbar control** (`VoiceCallToolbar.swift:22-73`): HStack spacing 10, padding 6 horizontal. **Audio details** (`LinkCall.swift`):
- **Chime**: two sine tones, 660 Hz at t0 and 880 Hz at t0 + 0.13 s. Each ramps linearly from 0 to 0.18 in 20 ms, decays exponentially to 0.001 by 0.28 s, and stops at 0.3 s. It plays on the speakers only, so the bot never hears it (`:209-223`).
- **Mute**: a GainNode set to 0 while the track keeps running (`:207`).
- **Noise floor**: white noise at ±0.002 amplitude loops into the outgoing stream, because "The voice model's clock only advances while audio arrives, and WebKit stops sending on digital silence" (`:96-97, 162-166`).
- **Connection setup**: ICE gathering waits up to 3 s, and the page opens a data channel `oai-events` (`:169, 180-184`).
- **Failure**: the page posts `{failed:true}` on a lost connection or rejected playback, which becomes "The call connection was lost." (`VoiceCall.swift:282-285`).

The Mac ignores the page's `{connected:true}` and starts the timer on the server's `started` alone. Mobile waits for both (`Mobile/Sources/NoodleMobile/Calls.swift:127-131`).

**What the bot hears.** At the start it is told: "<person> started a voice call with you from Noodle conversation <uuid>. Requests spoken on the call arrive here directly, not through Messenger. Your final message for a spoken request is read aloud on the call, so keep it brief and conversational, without Markdown, lists, links or code. …send files, links and anything that is better read than heard to the conversation through Messenger, and mention on the call that you sent them." At the end: "The voice call has ended. Answer later requests through Messenger as usual." Messages typed during the call are relayed as "Sent in the conversation during the call:\n<body>\nShared files: a, b" (`NoodleCore/VoiceCall.swift:68-86`).

**Voice chooser** (`AgentConfigurationFields.swift:153-168, 409-474`). The Harness tab has a row "Voice" with a `waveform` icon and the value "<Name>" or "Codex default". It opens a popover (arrow at the leading edge): width 340, padding 16, spacing 12, "Choose Voice" headline, groups "Feminine" and "Masculine" (caption semibold, secondary), each a 3-column grid with spacing 8. Tiles: min height 58, radius 10 continuous. Each shows `waveform` at 17 pt, with a variable-colour iterative symbol effect while its sample plays, accent if selected else secondary, above the name at 12.5 pt (semibold if selected). A selected tile has an accent-16% fill, a 1.5 pt accent border, and `checkmark.circle.fill` at 12 pt top right, inset 5. Unselected tiles are secondary at 8%. Help: "Choose <Name> and hear it". A click selects the voice and replays its sample from the start; one plays at a time, and closing stops it (`VoiceCall.swift:313-352`). `Support/VoicePreviews/` contains nine samples, `codex-{arbor,breeze,cove,ember,juniper,maple,sol,spruce,vale}.m4a`. **Panel** (`ScreenCapturePreview.swift:46-92`): 880×660 by default, min 580×440. It floats above other windows, joins all Spaces and full-screen apps, and is centred on the chat window's screen. **Becoming an attachment** (`CaptureAttachment.swift:20-43`; `NoodleStore.swift:1701-1708`). A plain capture is saved as "Capture — <title>.png" into the draft. An annotated one is validated first. Noodle then stores the source PNG as a conversation attachment and adds the marked "Annotation — Capture — <title>.png", with metadata, to the draft. If the second write fails, the first is rolled back. Titles have "/" and ":" turned into "-", are cut to 100 characters, and fall back to "Screen". The panel closes on save.

**Keyboard** (`ScreenCapturePreview.swift:126-165`):
- Return or Enter (no modifiers, no repeats) is intercepted while loading or live, and captures once a frame is live.
- Backspace returns to the picker while loading or live. While frozen it edits the comment instead.
- Escape retakes while frozen and closes otherwise. ⌘W closes.
- ⇧⌘S while open is swallowed, keeping the source and any annotation. ⇧⌘R and ⇧⌘A freeze. ⌘↩ adds while frozen.

This is out of primary scope but closely related. Bots can play **confetti** or **fireworks**; `docs/chat-effects.md` mentions only confetti (`Sources/NoodleCore/ConversationEffects.swift:5-8`). ## 3. Web translation (React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, Radix)

### 3.1 Voice messages

- **Capture**: `getUserMedia({ audio: { deviceId: saved ? { exact: saved } : undefined, echoCancellation: false, noiseSuppression: false, autoGainControl: false } })`. Noodle records raw input for messages, and AGC would make the silence and level logic lie (inferred). Keep one recorder per conversation in a store keyed by conversation id, so switching chats can finish (keep the draft) or discard (still preparing) exactly as Noodle does.
- **Encoding and durability**: use `MediaRecorder` with `start(1000)` and write each 1 s chunk plus metadata to IndexedDB (the analogue of writing `draft.json` every second), so a reload restores ready or failed. WebM from MediaRecorder often reports `duration = Infinity`. Count frames yourself, as Noodle does, and ship duration and waveform as metadata, so the player never needs to decode the file. An AudioWorklet writing 16-bit WAV is the alternative when exact seeking matters.
- **Metering**: use an AudioWorklet, not `AnalyserNode` polled on rAF, which misses peaks between frames. Emit one peak per 50 ms bucket. Main thread: keep a 240-entry ring for the live meter, append per-~85 ms peaks (cap 20,000) for the overview, and track `lastSignal` with a 0.0001 threshold.

```js
class PeakMeter extends AudioWorkletProcessor {            // bucket = 50 ms
  constructor() { super(); this.size = Math.round(sampleRate * 0.05); this.n = 0; this.peak = 0; }
  process([input]) { const ch = input[0]; if (!ch) return true;
    for (let i = 0; i < ch.length; i++) { const v = Math.abs(ch[i]); if (v > this.peak) this.peak = v;
      if (++this.n === this.size) { this.port.postMessage(Math.min(1, this.peak)); this.n = 0; this.peak = 0; } }
    return true; } }
registerProcessor('peak-meter', PeakMeter);
```

- **Live meter rendering**: one `<canvas>` (height 22, DPR-scaled), drawn on rAF with Mobile's clock rule `position = min(count, max(0, (elapsed - 0.25) / 0.05))`. Per bar: `x = W - age*5`, width 2.5, `h = min(H, 2 + max(0, norm*H - 2) * min(1, age))` with `norm = clamp((20*log10(max(1e-6,a)) + 60) / 48)`, `roundRect` radius 1.25, colour `currentColor` at 70%. Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, redraw at 10 fps.
- **Overview**: max-pool to ≤ 100 points on stop. Draw `min(60, n)` bars with a 2 px gap and `max(2, sqrt(v)*H)` height, radius 2; accent before the playhead, muted-foreground at 60% after it.
- **Transcription**: server-side after stop (Whisper or a hosted STT) while showing "Finishing transcription…" with a 30 s timeout. Or the Web Speech API (`continuous`, `interimResults`), joining final results plus the latest partial with spaces. It is not on-device in Chrome and missing in Firefox, so disclose that. Keep the rule that a failed or partial result never auto-sends: offer "Retry Transcription" or "Send Audio Only".
- **Recovery**: on `track.onended`, `onmute`, or no worklet messages for 1 s, show "Reconnecting microphone…" and re-acquire the same `deviceId` (up to 5 tries within 5 s). On failure, keep the chunks and enter failed with Noodle's copy. Silence of 3 s or more shows "No sound from {label}".
- **Device picker** (shadcn `Select` in settings): `enumerateDevices()` after permission (labels are empty before), refreshed on the `devicechange` event rather than 2 s polling. Store `deviceId` (stable per origin). Label "System Default — {label}" using Chrome's `default` entry, falling back to "System Default"; "Selected microphone unavailable".
- **Bar**: the same 36 px glass pill as the composer (radius 18), a flex row with gap 10: `X` (Escape), a 6 px red dot, the meter (`flex-1`), time (`tabular-nums text-[10px]`), Stop, Send (an ArrowUpCircle at 23 px). Bind Return and Escape at window level while recording, as Noodle's default and cancel actions do.
- **Player**: a hidden `<audio preload="metadata">` with one global "active player" (Zustand) so starting one pauses others. Position via a 100 ms interval or rAF. Seek on `click` only, from `offsetX / width`, and keep the element draggable for export. `role="slider"`, `aria-valuetext="m:ss"`, arrows ±5 s. Card: 270 px max, padding 12×7, radius 16, material background. Transcript: a Radix Dialog 440 px wide, scroll area max-height 340, "Transcript" and "Done".

### 3.2 Voice calls

- Port `LinkCallMedia.page` almost verbatim into a `useCallMedia()` hook. It is already browser code: `getUserMedia` with EC/NS/AGC on, a GainNode for mute (no renegotiation), the ±0.002 noise floor, `createDataChannel('oai-events')`, ICE gathering capped at 3 s, the chime oscillators, and `hangUp()` closing everything. No hidden window is needed, because the page is the window.
- Signalling: POST the offer to your backend, which relays it to the realtime voice provider and streams `answer | started | line | ended` back over WebSocket. Media flows directly between browser and provider, as in Noodle.
- Start `AudioContext.resume()` and `audio.play()` inside the Call click handler, because autoplay policy needs the gesture. Mark the call connected only when both the server says `started` and the page is media-ready, as Mobile does, not on `started` alone.
- UI: the toolbar control is a shadcn ghost icon `Button` (Phone) that becomes `[Phone green + timer] [Mic toggle, aria-pressed] [PhoneOff red]` with fixed widths. The timer is a `<span class="tabular-nums">` overlaid on an invisible "00:00" placeholder so the toolbar never shifts. The card and blocks are centred `div`s with the specs above. The full transcript is a Radix `Popover` 340×300 whose scroll container sits at the bottom on open (`scrollTop = scrollHeight`). Port `spokenLines` as a pure function feeding the transcript renderer.
- One call app-wide in a global store. Relay messages typed during the call using the exact "Sent in the conversation during the call:" format.
- Voice chooser: a Radix Popover, 340 wide, with a 3-column grid of 58 px tiles. Play `/voices/{provider}-{id}.m4a` with a single shared `Audio` element that restarts on every click.

### 3.3 Annotations

- **Text**: on the shortcut, read `window.getSelection()`. Require the anchor and focus nodes inside the same `[data-message-id]` element and the active element not to be the composer. Quote = `toString()`, non-blank. No clipboard round-trip is needed. Replace Noodle's beep with a visible toast, such as "Select text in one message", since beeps are invisible on the web.
- **Region of the conversation**: rasterise the chat pane with `modern-screenshot` or `html-to-image`. This needs no permission, but `backdrop-filter` glass and cross-origin wallpapers render imperfectly. The fallback is `getDisplayMedia({ preferCurrentTab: true })` (Chrome) and cropping the frame to the pane's `getBoundingClientRect() × devicePixelRatio`, at the cost of a prompt. Lay the bitmap exactly over the pane so it appears to freeze in place.
- **Overlay**: a fixed `div` with `cursor: crosshair`. Pointer events use `setPointerCapture`, and `wheel` is prevented (`passive: false`). The selection element gets `border: 3px solid var(--orange)` and `background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--orange) 14%, transparent)`. Dim everything else with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax rgb(0 0 0 / .15)` on the selection itself. The hint pill ("Drag to select · Esc to cancel", 30 px tall, radius 15, HUD blur) sits 16 px right of and 14 px below the pointer, flips near edges with 8 px margins, and hides on pointerdown. A drag under 4 px becomes a 16×16 marker centred on pointerdown. Store fractions; Noodle uses a bottom-left origin, so convert if you share data with it.
- **Popover**: a Radix `Popover` with `<Popover.Anchor virtualRef={{ current: { getBoundingClientRect: () => DOMRect.fromRect({ x, y, width: 1, height: 1 }) } }}>`. Use `side="right"` unless `x + 346 + 30 > innerWidth`, then `"left"`. Content 346×278 with a 60 px reference box, an 88 px textarea (placeholder "What should change?"), a hint row and a "Save" button 74 px wide. ⌘↩ saves, Escape cancels, and `onInteractOutside` is prevented to match `.applicationDefined`.
- **Marked PNG**: an `OffscreenCanvas` at the bitmap's size. `strokeRect` with `lineWidth = lw + 2` and `rgb(0 0 0 / .7)`, then `lw` with `rgb(255 140 0)`, where `lw = max(2, width / 450)`; then `convertToBlob({ type: 'image/png' })`.
- **Persistence and sending**: upload the source and the note in one server transaction (source first, rolled back on failure). Add the note to the conversation's server-side draft attachments so it survives reloads, and render chips (28 px glass capsules, max 260 px). Editing is allowed while the note is unsent; after Send it is read-only. The review window is a non-modal Radix Dialog with the dark frame (header 36 px, radius 18, inset 5 px at radius 13).

### 3.4 Screen capture

- The browser's own chooser replaces Noodle's thumbnail grid, since the web cannot enumerate windows or show thumbnails before consent. Call `getDisplayMedia({ video: { frameRate: { max: 10 }, displaySurface: 'window' }, audio: false, selfBrowserSurface: 'exclude', surfaceSwitching: 'include' })`. `displaySurface: 'window'` mirrors the Windows default, and `selfBrowserSurface: 'exclude'` mirrors excluding the capture panel. Show the "Allow screen previews" explanation before the first call. `NotAllowedError` returns to it with "Try Again"; there is no settings deep link, and `display-capture` cannot be queried reliably (inferred).
- Phase mapping: choosing = before or while the browser prompt is open; loading = until `loadeddata`, with an 8 s timeout; live = a `<video autoplay muted playsinline>` letterboxed on black 65% with padding 12 and a green "Live" pill; annotating = draw the current frame to a canvas (`ImageCapture.grabFrame()` where available) and stop the tracks; Retake = `getDisplayMedia` again. Map `track.onended` (the user pressed "Stop sharing") to "The source stopped providing images. Retake or choose another source."
- Panel: a floating, draggable and resizable dark frame (`react-rnd` or similar), 880×660 with a minimum of 580×440, kind label "Preview". Footer actions exactly as in 2.5. Return captures, Backspace means Choose Another, Escape retakes or closes, ⌘↩ adds.
- Output: `canvas.toBlob('image/png')` named `Capture — {track.label sanitised, ≤100}.png` into the draft, or the source plus the marked note when annotated.

### 3.5 Noodlets

- Treat a noodlet as an HTML bundle served from an isolated origin per noodlet (for example `https://{id}.noodlets.example`) and run it in `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-pointer-lock" allow="...">`. Grant `microphone`, `camera`, `gamepad` and `fullscreen` only after a one-time "Allow" or "Don't Allow" grant matching manifest `permissions`. Never combine `allow-same-origin` with your app's origin.
- Card: `div` 304 px max, padding 12, radius 13, `bg-muted/35`-style fill; a 150 px thumbnail area with `object-contain`; title (13 px bold, 1 line); caption "Noodlet · Click to open" or "Noodlet unavailable". Lazy-load the preview with IntersectionObserver, allow at most 2 concurrent preview fetches, and cache by URL for the Shared popover. Click or Space opens a floating panel in the dark frame (kind "Noodlet", ⌘W closes).
- In-place annotation: inject a small bridge script into the noodlet origin. On `postMessage({ type: 'selection' })` it replies with `{ selection: getSelection().toString(), text: document.body.innerText.slice(0, 200000) }`. For a region, either the bridge rasterises its own document and posts back a PNG, since the parent cannot read a cross-origin frame, or `getDisplayMedia({ preferCurrentTab: true })` is cropped to the iframe rect. Then show the same region overlay over the iframe.

### 3.6 Shortcut collisions on the web

Noodle's defaults clash with browser shortcuts: ⇧⌘R is a hard reload, ⇧⌘A is Chrome tab search, ⇧⌘D bookmarks all tabs, ⇧⌘C opens DevTools' element inspector, and ⇧⌘S is Firefox's screenshot (browser behaviour, not from the repo; which ones a page can `preventDefault` varies by browser and is unverified). Keep Noodle's model of remappable bindings with a reserved list and conflict errors (`KeyboardShortcuts.swift:41-56, 133-157`), and add browser-reserved combinations to that list. Ship the menus and an on-screen command palette so nothing depends only on a chord.

## 4. Patterns worth copying, and pitfalls to avoid

**Copy:**
1. **Media carries its own presentation metadata.** Voice attachments ship duration, a ≤100-point waveform and the transcript, so bubbles render instantly and bots get text without re-transcribing.
2. **Two waveforms for two jobs**: a fixed time-scale live meter (50 ms buckets, 12 s, −60 to −12 dB window, bars growing in) and a whole-recording overview (max-pooled, `sqrt` height, ≤60 bars, progress tint).
3. **Never silently degrade**: no partial transcript is ever sent, and "Retry Transcription" and "Send Audio Only" are explicit choices; 10 minutes ends the recording but never sends it.
4. **Durable drafts everywhere**: recordings written every second, annotations kept as draft attachments until a sent message references them, both restored after relaunch.
5. **Generation tokens on every async step** (`generation` UUID checks in the recorder, capture model, annotation controllers and call controller), so late frames, permissions or results cannot touch a newer session or another conversation.
6. **Stable chrome under live state**: the call timer slot is reserved at "00:00" width; region-note thumbnails reserve a height of 190; reaction space is reserved so rows never jump.
7. **Calls as conversation artifacts**: no modal call screen. A card plus time-ordered transcript blocks split by typed messages keeps one ordered record, and the chat stays usable during the call.
8. **One owner per exclusive medium**: one playing voice message, one preview sample, one call, one capture panel, one annotation session.
9. **Click versus drag**: click seeks, drag exports, and the hint pill never intercepts the selection gesture.
10. **Annotations as readable files plus metadata**: the PNG mark has a dark halo for contrast, the text note has a readable layout, and the structured metadata is authoritative.
11. **Picker hygiene**: thumbnails are validated (alpha coverage, a settling frame) and tiles are published only in final order, so the grid never reshuffles under the pointer.

**Avoid:**
1. Default chords that collide with the browser (3.6).
2. Copying stale Noodle copy: "Settings → Chat" (the tab is Conversation), "Preview → Add Annotation" (that menu is gone), and docs listing confetti only.
3. Dead UI: the capture editor's "Select a region in the image above." can never show, because the editor appears only once a region exists (`ScreenCapturePreview.swift:192-195, 308`).
4. The Mac starting the call timer and chime on the server's `started` even if media never flows. Prefer Mobile's both-ready rule.
5. Inconsistent tokens: the recording bar's Send is hard-coded system blue while the composer's Send uses the accent colour. Use one token.
6. Beeps as the only failure feedback for annotation preconditions (selection spans messages, composer focused, noodlet off screen). On the web, show a message.
7. `AnalyserNode` on rAF for peaks, AGC-on capture for messages, and trusting MediaRecorder's duration.
8. Expecting DOM rasterisation to reproduce glass and blur. The frozen picture may visibly differ from the live pane, so either accept that or use tab capture.
9. Silence on the wire in realtime calls. Keep the noise-floor technique, or the provider's turn-taking can stall while the person is muted.

## 5. Open questions and inferences

- **No screenshots** of the recording bar, call controls, call card, transcript blocks, annotation popover, review window or capture panel exist. All their specs come from code, and on-screen rendering (glass toolbar treatment, default SF Symbol sizes of about 13 pt in `.body`) is inferred.
- The audio format `SpeechAnalyzer.bestAvailableAudioFormat` picks is unknown. "~85 ms per overview peak" assumes a 48 kHz input with 4096-frame taps (inferred).
- Colours: SwiftUI `.red`, `.green`, `.blue` and AppKit `systemOrange` are system colours with no values in the repo. Apple's published values are red #FF3B30 / #FF453A, green #34C759 / #30D158, blue #007AFF / #0A84FF, orange #FF9500 / #FF9F0A (light / dark), from Apple's HIG, not verified here.
- Noodle Applet's side of in-place annotation (`Applet/Sources/NoodleApplet/WebRunner.swift`, `Runtime.swift`) and the Hub call path (`HubMirror.openCall`, `HubBots.swift`) were not read. Behaviour is described from the Noodle side only.
- The Mac ignores the page's `{connected: true}` message (`VoiceCall.swift:282-285`), apparently by design. Whether a call can show "connected" with no audio in practice is untested.
- The quote check for conversation text requires the quote to occur in the rendered Markdown. Selections that span Markdown table segments, or that leave the message, probably fail silently with a beep (inferred).
- Whether browsers let pages override ⇧⌘R, ⇧⌘D and ⇧⌘A with `preventDefault` varies and is unverified.
- The noodlet card's title (`.headline`) and the timer's fonts inherit toolbar or system defaults. Exact rendered sizes in macOS 26 toolbars are inferred.

doc:docs-internal/research/noodle/analys.content:
# Noodle: creating and configuring bots and groups

Noodle's "hire" flow is a single fixed-width sheet (New Bot, 520 pt) whose header holds Cancel, a centred title and a plain-text primary action, and whose body is an identity row (64 pt avatar with a pencil badge plus a pre-filled, regenerable name field) above a five-segment tab picker: General (public description, private backstory, folders), Harness (a grouped card of harness, profile, model, effort and voice rows that open popovers), Tools, Computers and Browsers (assignment "wells" fed by search-and-add popovers). Edit Bot reuses the same sheet and adds sharing, the conversation background, Delete Bot, and a transactional save that snapshots the bot's settings files and restores them if any write fails. Groups use smaller sheets (New Group 480 pt, Group Info 460 pt) built from a name field, a description, an avatar-grid member picker with confirm-on-remove, an optional location tile row (This Mac or a joined Noodle Hub), folders and the background. Avatars are a circle that shows either an uploaded/generated JPEG or an SF Symbol on one of six two-stop gradients; backgrounds are per-conversation presets, photos, videos, multi-frame HEICs or system wallpapers, dimmed by a 25 % black scrim and forcing the window into dark appearance. Note that in this codebase "Kick" means recovering a failed bot, not removing a group member; removal is the confirm-on-remove action in the member picker.

Permalink base for every `path:line` citation below: https://github.com/pdparchitect/noodle/blob/702339e3153025c9fe9582783caff7a19b48ff97/

## 1. Scope

Read in full (assigned):
- `Sources/Noodle/`: `Overlays.swift`, `AgentConfigurationFields.swift`, `AgentPicker.swift`, `AgentProfileSheet.swift`, `AgentProfileButton.swift`, `GroupMemberPicker.swift`, `MCPAssignmentPicker.swift`, `CompanionAssignmentPicker.swift`, `BotFolderPicker.swift`, `AgentSettingsCheckpoint.swift`, `DestructiveActionButton.swift`, `GroupsSettingsView.swift`, `FirstBotSetupSheet.swift`.
- `Sources/NoodleRuntimeSettings/`: `BotsSettingsView.swift`, `BotAvatar.swift`, `BotSettingsHost.swift`, `HarnessProviderIcon.swift`, `AgentKickConfirmation.swift`.
- `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/NoodleWallpaper/`: `IconEditorSheet.swift`, `IconAppearance.swift`, `BackgroundPicker.swift`, `ImageSourceMenu.swift`, `SystemWallpaperSheet.swift`, `NoodleImagePlaygroundButton.swift`, `CameraView.swift`, `BackgroundDropTarget.swift`, `CompanionContentPanel.swift`.
- `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/NoodleWallpaperCore/*.swift` (AvatarIdea, BackgroundDrop, BackgroundMedia, BackgroundPhoto, ConversationBackground, ImagePlaygroundSetup, SystemWallpaper); `Shared/SettingsUI/Sources/NoodleSettingsUI/SheetSizing.swift`.

Consulted for exact copy or behaviour (partial reads): `Sources/Noodle/{NoodleStore,NoodleApp,SidebarView,ConversationBackgroundView,Components,ComputerController,BrowserController,EventKitController,BotNameGenerator,StarterTeam,FirstBotSetup,MessageContextMenu,ConversationWindow,NoodleSettingsView}.swift`; `Sources/NoodleCore/{ConversationName,Models,Harnesses,KeyboardShortcuts,AgentFolder,AgentConfiguration,ConversationBackground,BackgroundMedia,WorkspaceRepository,EventKitAccess}.swift`; `Sources/NoodleRuntime/{AgentRuntimeCoordinator,BotVoice}.swift`; `Sources/NoodleRuntimeSettings/{ToolCatalogView,MCPSettingsView,SettingsRowList,SettingsStatusLabel,ConversationRuntimeSettings}.swift`; `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/NoodleWallpaper/{ConversationBackgroundView,AnimatedWallpaper}.swift`; `Shared/HubLink/Sources/HubLink/LinkProtocol.swift`; `Mobile/Sources/NoodleMobile/Chats.swift`; `.agents/skills/ui-copy/SKILL.md` and `AGENTS.md` (read as data describing Noodle's own conventions).

Screenshots viewed:
- `website/assets/mobile-new-bot.png`: despite the filename, the iOS bot editor in edit mode (Cancel/Save, 88 pt avatar with tinted "Edit", Name, Harness "Claude Code", Model "Default", Tools/Computers/Browsers rows, Background, red Delete Bot at the bottom). Matches `Mobile/Sources/NoodleMobile/Chats.swift:2158-2298`.
- `website/assets/mobile-new-tool.png`: iOS "New Tool" catalogue (brand icon, tinted name, one-line summary, bottom "Search tools" field).
- `website/assets/screenshot-chloe.png`: macOS direct conversation; illustrated portrait avatars in the sidebar with a green runtime dot; a large avatar and name over an illustrated, dimmed wallpaper.
- `website/assets/screenshot-group-chat.png`: macOS group "Launch week"; stacked three-member group avatar, group description and member list under the title, photo wallpaper (rocket launch) dimmed.

## 2. Findings

### 2.1 Entry points, presentation and sizing

- Toolbar Create menu: `Label("Create", systemImage: "plus")`, tooltip "Create Bot or Group"; items "New Bot" (`person.crop.circle.badge.plus`) and "New Group" (`person.3.fill`) (`Sources/Noodle/NoodleApp.swift:369-386`). File menu replaces New Item with the same two commands (`NoodleApp.swift:138-149`). Default shortcuts ⌘N and ⇧⌘N, user-rebindable (`Sources/NoodleCore/KeyboardShortcuts.swift:95-96`).
- New Bot is disabled unless storage is ready and either a local harness is installed or a joined Hub lends one (`Sources/Noodle/NoodleStore.swift:313-315`); New Group is disabled while there are no bots (`NoodleApp.swift:381`, `529-531`).
- Editing: the toolbar's primary action is an `ellipsis` button labelled "Edit Bot" (direct chat, not for shared bots) or "Group Info" (`NoodleApp.swift:466-485`). Sidebar context menu: "Edit Bot…" / "Edit Group…", "Change Background…", then for bots that run on this Mac "Show Activity", "Show Usage", "Show Workspace in Finder", "Kick" (only when failed), "New Session", and finally "Archive Bot" / "Archive Group" (`Sources/Noodle/SidebarView.swift:77-138`). The Apple Intelligence model managers in Settings open Edit Bot directly on the Harness tab for a bot that uses a model (`Sources/Noodle/NoodleSettingsView.swift:232-234`; `Sources/NoodleRuntimeSettings/AppleLocalModelsView.swift:98-100`).
- Every sheet has a fixed width and a content-fitted height:

| Sheet / popover | Width x height (pt) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| New Bot, Edit Bot | 520 x fitted (animated resize) | `Overlays.swift:182`, `426`; `NoodleApp.swift:496-512` |
| New Group | 480 x fitted | `Overlays.swift:981` |
| Group Info | 460 x fitted | `Overlays.swift:823` |
| Folders (sub-sheet) | 480 x fitted | `BotFolderPicker.swift:66` |
| Bot Icon editor | 440 x fitted | `IconEditorSheet.swift:104` |
| Conversation Background | 520 x fitted | `Sources/Noodle/ConversationBackgroundView.swift:60` |
| System Wallpapers | 720 x 560 | `SystemWallpaperSheet.swift:51` |
| Camera | 320 x 320 circle + 20 padding | `CameraView.swift:131-133` |
| New Computer / New Browser | 420 x fitted | `ComputerController.swift:363`, `BrowserController.swift:218` |
| New Tool catalogue | 480 x fitted (list 310 tall) | `ToolCatalogView.swift:51`, `61` |
| First-run setup | 640 x fitted | `FirstBotSetupSheet.swift:35` |
| Bot / group profile (popover) | 320 x fitted | `AgentProfileSheet.swift:72`, `290` |

- `noodleSheetSizing(animated:)` = `fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)` + `.presentationSizing(.fitted)` + an AppKit bridge that measures the SwiftUI content and resizes the sheet window outside the layout pass, coalescing measurements, ignoring changes under 0.5 pt, and, when animated (and Reduce Motion is off), keeping the sheet attached at its top edge while it grows or shrinks (`Shared/SettingsUI/Sources/NoodleSettingsUI/SheetSizing.swift:4-68`). The comment states why: macOS keeps a sheet's initial size, and recreating the editor would lose drafts, focus and nested presentations (`SheetSizing.swift:16-18`). New Bot and Edit Bot use the animated variant, so switching tabs smoothly resizes the sheet.

### 2.2 Shared sheet anatomy

All editors share one header pattern: `HStack { Button("Cancel") Spacer Text(title).font(.headline) Spacer Button(primary) }.padding(16)`, both buttons `.buttonStyle(.plain)` with `.foregroundStyle(.blue)`; the primary turns `.secondary` and disabled when invalid (`Overlays.swift:257-271`, `321-333`, `761-773`, `905-925`). A full-width `Divider()` follows, then the body padded 20 (`Overlays.swift:180`, `424`, `821`). The bot and group editors do not use `Form`; they compose caption-semibold labels, rounded-border fields, caption helper text and tinted "well" containers in a `VStack` (New Bot spacing 16, Edit Bot 18, Group Info 18). `Form` with `.formStyle(.grouped)` is used for Settings tabs and the small New Computer / New Browser sheets.

Keyboard: Return in the name field submits when valid (`Overlays.swift:105-107`, `360`, `790`). Cancel in the four bot/group editors has no `.cancelAction` shortcut attached; Folders and Conversation Background bind their Apply to `.defaultAction` (`BotFolderPicker.swift:61`, `ConversationBackgroundView.swift:43`); Camera binds Take Photo to `.defaultAction`; New Computer/Browser bind both Cancel and Create (`ComputerController.swift:345-349`).

### 2.3 New Bot sheet (`Overlays.swift:43-272`)

**Identity row** (`HStack(spacing: 14)`, `Overlays.swift:80-129`):
- Avatar button: `BotAvatar` 64 pt with `pencil.circle.fill` at 21 pt in the bottom-trailing corner, palette rendering white on accent, on a background-coloured circle; plain style; tooltip and accessibility label "Change Bot Icon"; opens the icon editor sheet (`Overlays.swift:81-95`, `194-202`).
- Name column `VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 5)`: `TextField("Bot name")`, `.roundedBorder`, 14 pt, one line, autocorrect on, focused on appear. A regenerate button sits inside the field's trailing edge: `arrow.triangle.2.circlepath`, 11 pt semibold, secondary, 22x22 hit area, 4 pt trailing inset, pointing-hand cursor, tooltip "Try Another Name", accessibility "Generate Another Name"; it replaces the name with a new random one (never the current one) and refocuses the field (`Overlays.swift:98-124`). Caption below, secondary: "You can rename this bot later without changing its workspace location." (`Overlays.swift:125-127`). The claim holds because workspaces are keyed by the bot's UUID, not its name (`Sources/NoodleCore/WorkspaceRepository.swift:126-127`).
- Validation line under the whole row (not under the field): `NameValidationMessage`, caption, red, wrapping (`Overlays.swift:31-41`, `131`).

**Name generation** (`Sources/Noodle/BotNameGenerator.swift:3-69`): the name is pre-filled on appear (`Overlays.swift:184`). Style is a global setting, "Generated bot names": Real (default) picks from 110 first names (Ada, Adrian, Aisha, ... Zara, Zoe); Playful combines one of 32 descriptors (Amber, Bright, Brisk, Calm, ...) with one of 32 companions (Badger, Beacon, Birch, ...) as "Clever Otter". Up to 8 draws avoid repeating the current name; fallbacks "Alex" / "Noodle".

**Name validation** (`Sources/NoodleCore/ConversationName.swift:4-31`), applied to bot and group names, on the trimmed value:

| Rule | Message |
|---|---|
| empty after trimming | "Enter a name." |
| contains a newline or control character | "Names must be a single line. Put longer text in Description or Backstory." |
| more than 100 characters | "Keep names to 100 characters or fewer." |

The message renders only while the raw field is non-empty (`Overlays.swift:34`), so an empty field shows nothing, but Create stays disabled. Create additionally requires a usable harness: a Hub-lent harness, or a local installation of the selected provider (`Overlays.swift:205-210`).

**Tab picker** (`Overlays.swift:11-29`): `Picker("Bot settings")`, segmented, label hidden, fixed to its intrinsic width and centred; selection changes animate with `easeInOut(0.22)` unless Reduce Motion. Segments in order: General, Harness, Tools, Computers, Browsers (enum raw values; the cases are `general`, `runtime`, `mcp`, `computers`, `browsers`). If the chosen harness moves between this Mac and a Hub (or between Hubs), New Bot clears the tool, computer and browser selections because IDs from one home mean nothing in another (`Overlays.swift:18-19`, `27`, `133-135`). Under every tab except Harness, New Bot repeats the experimental-harness warning (`Overlays.swift:176-178`).

**Field table, New Bot**

| # | Tab | Label | Control | Placeholder / value | Default | Validation / notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | header | Icon | 64 pt avatar button | "Change Bot Icon" tooltip | symbol `sparkles`, colour random 0-5 | (`Overlays.swift:56-57`) |
| 2 | header | Name | text field + regenerate | "Bot name" | random name | ConversationName rules |
| 3 | General | Description | multi-line text field, 2-3 lines | "Briefly describe what this bot does…" | empty | none; trimmed, empty saved as null |
| 4 | General | Backstory | 160 pt text editor | "Describe who this bot is, its role, tone, or priorities…" | empty | none; trimmed |
| 5 | General | Folders | disclosure row opening a sheet | "None" or count | none | max 16 folders; hidden for Hub harnesses |
| 6 | Harness | Harness | row + popover | provider name or "Choose a harness" | space's Hub harness, else first installed | must be installed or lent |
| 7 | Harness | Profile | row + popover | "System" or profile name | System | shown only when the provider supports profiles and has some |
| 8 | Harness | Model | row + searchable popover | "<Provider> default" | "" (harness default) | resets when harness changes |
| 9 | Harness | Effort | stepped slider | "Model default" | "" | snaps to the model's default if unsupported |
| 10 | Harness | Voice | row + tile popover | voice name or "<Provider> default" | follows the name | shown when the provider has voices |
| 11 | Tools | Tools | list well + chooser | "Add tools to this bot" | none | |
| 12 | Computers | Computers | grid well + chooser | "Add computers to this bot" | none | |
| 13 | Browsers | Browsers | grid well + chooser | "Add browsers to this bot" | none | |

**Description vs backstory** (`Overlays.swift:634-695`):
- Description: label "Description" (caption, semibold), `TextField(..., axis: .vertical)`, rounded border, `lineLimit(2...3)`; helper (caption, secondary): "Visible to other bots in shared groups. The private backstory below is never included." It is the bot's public record: profiles, participant lists and other bots see it.
- Backstory: label "Backstory"; a custom editor, because SwiftUI's `TextEditor` has no placeholder: a `ZStack` of a continuous 8 pt rounded rectangle filled `secondary` at 10 % opacity, a 13 pt tertiary placeholder (9 pt horizontal, 4 pt vertical inset, hit-testing off), and a 13 pt `TextEditor` with its scroll background hidden and 4 pt padding; fixed height 160; 1 pt stroke `secondary` at 18 %. No helper text. Stored privately in `agent.json` and deliberately never added to `AgentRecord` (`Sources/NoodleCore/AgentConfiguration.swift:15-34`); the profile sheet "Deliberately uses only the public record, never the workspace/backstory" (`AgentProfileSheet.swift:8`). Changing the backstory on an existing bot starts a fresh harness session on save (`NoodleStore.swift:1074-1075`; same path as New Session, `AgentRuntimeCoordinator.swift:764-768`).

**Harness tab** (`AgentConfigurationFields.swift:85-216`): a caption-semibold "Harness" label over a grouped card: continuous 12 pt radius, fill `secondary` at 7.5 %, 1 pt stroke `secondary` at 11 %; rows separated by dividers inset 44 pt (`:170-174`, `108`). Each `RuntimeSelectionRow` is 50 pt tall, 12 pt horizontal padding, `HStack(spacing: 11)`: a 20x20 secondary icon, then a caption secondary title over a 13 pt medium value (one line, optional model tag capsule), a 12 pt minimum spacer, and a trailing `chevron.right` (caption semibold, tertiary) or a small spinner while capabilities load (`:218-257`). Rows and their SF Symbols: Harness (provider brand mark via `HarnessProviderIcon`, fallback `terminal`), Profile (`person.crop.circle`), Model (`cube.transparent`), Effort (`bolt.fill`), Voice (`waveform`). Popovers attach with `arrowEdge: .leading`.

### 2.5 Settings checkpointing (`AgentSettingsCheckpoint.swift:4-50`)

Not a user-facing undo. Before create or update, the store snapshots the app-owned settings files: `computers.json`, `browsers.json`, `calendars.json`, `reminders.json` at the root, `MCP/connections.json`, the bot's `agent.json` and its direct conversation's `conversation.json` (32 MiB read limit each, absent files recorded as absent). If any step throws, `restore()` walks the entries in reverse, rewrites only files whose bytes differ, deletes files that did not exist, and rethrows the first error; transcripts, runtime state and the bot's working files are never copied. Directory descriptors keep restoration inside the original folders even if a path changes. The user sees the original error in the "Noodle" alert; only if the restore itself fails is a suffix appended: " Previous settings were restored where possible; workspace repair is still needed: ..." on edit, " Previous settings could not be fully restored: ..." on create (`NoodleStore.swift:935-946`, `1056-1068`).

### 2.8 "Kick" means recovery, not removal

"Kick" is a sidebar context-menu item shown only when a bot's runtime has failed (`SidebarView.swift:118-123`). An ordinary kick restarts immediately; failures that need consent return a request shown by `AgentKickConfirmation` as an alert (`AgentKickConfirmation.swift:6-39`; copy in `Sources/NoodleRuntime/AgentRuntimeCoordinator.swift:53-95`):

| Failure | Title | Confirm | Extra buttons | Message (abridged only where marked) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| missing session | "Recover <name>?" | "Recover Bot" | Cancel | "The previous session is unavailable. Noodle can start a replacement and help <name> continue using your conversation history." + "Your messages, files, and bot settings will be kept. Details remembered only within the previous session may be lost." |
| usage limit | "Usage limit reached" | "Retry Now" | Cancel | "The harness's usage limit has been reached. Once usage is available again, retry to continue. Restarting cannot restore usage. Your session and unfinished work will be kept." |
| sign-in needed | "Sign in to reconnect <name>" | "Retry Now" | "Open Harness Settings", Cancel | "The harness needs you to sign in again. Open Harness settings for sign-in options, then retry. Your session and unfinished work will be kept." |
| recovery failed | "Retry recovery?" | "Retry Now" | Cancel | "Noodle will retry recovery using your conversation history. Your messages and files will be kept." |
| safety stop | "Safeguards stopped <name>" | "Resume" | "New Session", Cancel | "The model's safeguards stopped a response. Resume continues the same session. New Session starts with a fresh context and keeps the workspace, memory and messages." |

The modifier is attached to the containing view "so closing a context menu cannot dismiss the alert" (`AgentKickConfirmation.swift:5`). Removing a member from a group is covered in 2.7.
